scheme_name: Mukhyamantri Bagwani Mission: Anjeer Vikas Yojana
other_conditions: Applicant must own agricultural land between 0.25 and 10 acres (0.1–4 ha).
Applicant must be registered on the DBT portal.
Beneficiaries are selected on a first‑come‑first‑serve basis.
benefits_summary: Financial assistance of ₹30,000 per hectare in the first year and ₹10,000 per hectare in the second and third years, along with supply of high‑quality fig plants.
